correctness.rationale: Depth-one characteristic formulas isolate exact pointed types (input color and K-capped local color histogram). Every term factors through them, and every Boolean subset of realizable types is a term. Explicit realization yields a disjoint uncapped term and capped sum bounded by largest block; coefficient extraction matches both. For K>=2, uncapped size-s polynomials have exact degree s-1 with positive leading coefficient; capped terms of maximal size M have degree <=M-K, so polynomial equality over infinitely many alphabet sizes 2^r recovers M then every member of the size set. For K=1, the formula reduces to q sum_{j=0}^{M-1} binom(q-1,j), recovering only M. Standalone verifier tested 496 formula cases, 114816 explicit colorings, 5862 pointed-refinement states, nine direct term closures; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Determining what concrete frame information is recoverable from intrinsic arity-wise term-operation counts is a natural universal-algebra and epistemic-logic question. The theorem gives a complete structural invariant for arbitrary finite partitions, not a numerological example or a routine singleton reduction. The threshold-two jump is a sharp definability/reconstruction phenomenon and the explicit coefficient formula makes the invariants computable. Multiplicity invisibility is an exact boundary.
